scope: Original AST-extracted methods with recording Sandbox and run_agent replacements. Captured arguments and settings only; no shell, remote files, actual CLI, network, or signal was executed. run_agent return 0 is supplied by the recorder. SWE_PROMPT uses its default literal, with no SWE_CC_PROMPT override.

exec.cmd: mkdir -p /home/agent/.claude && echo '{"hasCompletedOnboarding": true, "bypassPermissionsModeAccepted": true, "hooks": {"PreCompact": [{"hooks": [{"type": "command", "command": "python3 /tmp/slime-claude-compaction.py /workspace/repo/.harness 2", "timeout": 10}]}], "PostCompact": [{"hooks": [{"type": "command", "command": "python3 /tmp/slime-claude-compaction.py /workspace/repo/.harness 2", "timeout": 10}]}]}}' | tee /home/agent/.claude.json /home/agent/.claude/settings.json > /dev/null && chown -R agent:agent /home/agent/.claude /home/agent/.claude.json

input.prompt: Read PROBLEM_STATEMENT.md in the current directory and resolve the issue. Edit source files only (do NOT touch tests). After editing, run the relevant tests to verify your fix passes. Do NOT modify PROBLEM_STATEMENT.md and do NOT commit. When finished, print a one-line summary and exit.

run_agent_arguments.start_cmd:
printf '%s\n' '{"attempts":0,"count":0,"limit_reached":false}' > /workspace/repo/.harness/compaction.json; /usr/local/bin/claude -p 'Read PROBLEM_STATEMENT.md in the current directory and resolve the issue. Edit source files only (do NOT touch tests). After editing, run the relevant tests to verify your fix passes. Do NOT modify PROBLEM_STATEMENT.md and do NOT commit. When finished, print a one-line summary and exit.' --permission-mode bypassPermissions --output-format stream-json --include-partial-messages --include-hook-events --verbose &
slime_cli_pid=$!
printf '%s\n' "$slime_cli_pid" > /workspace/repo/.harness/cli.pid
wait "$slime_cli_pid"
